result.summary: A direct free kick executed from outside the penalty area curls over the defensive wall and finishes in the net for a goal.

observations.title: Defensive wall and attacking alignment
observations.body: The defending side sets a four-man wall centrally just outside the penalty box. Attacking players in white position themselves wide and on the shoulder of the wall to create lanes and prepare for rebounds.

observations.title: Direct free-kick strike
observations.body: The set-piece taker strikes the ball cleanly with elevation, clearing the four-man wall and directing it toward the upper corner out of the reach of the goalkeeper.

observations.title: Secondary crash runs into the box
observations.body: As the strike is taken, attacking runners immediately break into the penalty area to contest any spilled ball or rebound off the woodwork.
